fusions.name: Cold Chisel
fusions.desc: A sting driven into the target's plating that deals 7 damage and leaves it 8% easier to wound for 5 seconds. Holds 3 charges, and kills give charges back.

fusions.name: Rivet Shot
fusions.desc: Fires a stinger that deals 12 damage, knocks the target back 2.5 tiles and leaves it [Sundered] for 6 seconds.

fusions.name: Unbending Plate
fusions.desc: Raises a barrier that absorbs the next 18 damage for 6 seconds and raises your armour by 10%. You move 15% faster for 3 seconds after.

fusions.name: Dents Become Plate
fusions.desc: Every time you take damage, a stack builds on you, up to 8. At 8 they all spend at once into a shield that soaks 7% of your maximum health per stack. Unfed, a stack fades every 10 seconds. Your armour rises by 5%.
